sections.t: A Merchant with an Odd Quirk
p: Remy "Two Times" trades from Goldshire, where he deals with travelers. He came west from the Redridge Mountains. When he speaks, he usually repeats the last words of each sentence twice. The odd habit gives him his nickname, but it does not keep him from seeking a profit in troubled Elwynn Forest.

Kobolds overrun the local gold mines, and aggressive murlocs infest the riverbanks, disrupting trade in Elwynn. Remy turns to travelers for help. He pays for pouches of gold dust gathered from kobolds in the mines and keeps watch on suspicious murloc movements near Crystal Lake.
